gold: Left maxillary giant cell reparative granuloma (GCRG)

selector.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components in the left maxillary sinus, erosion of the orbital floor, and displacement of the inferior rectus muscle without invasion, along with the patient's age and sex, support Juvenile Nasopharyngeal Angiofibroma as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis
rejected.why: Lack of systemic symptoms and specific findings for Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis

rejected.label: Fibrous Dysplasia
rejected.why: The presence of a distinct mass and absence of typical fibrous dysplasia features
